title: 間 — “during ～ / while ～ / between ～”
summary: 間 (aida) means a span of time or space. It expresses “during ～” or “while ～,” and also “between A and B.” For time, it follows a noun + の or a verb (usually in a continuing form, like ～ている).

patterns.gloss: Noun + の + 間: during that period (e.g. 夏休みの間)

patterns.form: 動詞（普通形・ている）＋ 間
patterns.gloss: Verb (plain form, often ～ている) + 間: while something continues (e.g. 見ていた間)

patterns.form: A と B の 間
patterns.gloss: A と B の 間: between A and B (place)

body.p: 間 looks at a stretch of time and says something is going on the whole time, from start to finish. In 授業の間、ずっと外を見ていた, the looking continued throughout the class.

With a noun, use の: 夏休みの間. With a verb, use a form that shows continuing action or state: 待っている間, 寝ている間, 日本にいる間. Na-adjectives take な (静かな間) and i-adjectives attach directly. The sentence after 間 often has ずっと.

body.h: 間 vs 間に, and the place meaning
body.p: 間 (without に) is for something continuing the whole time. 間に is for a single event that happens at some point within the period: 留守の間に電話があった. The same word also means “between” for places: 駅と学校の間に店がある.

examples.ja: 夏休（なつやす）みの間（あいだ）、国（くに）へ帰（かえ）ります。
examples.romaji: Natsuyasumi no aida, kuni e kaerimasu.
examples.tr: I'll go back to my country during the summer vacation.
examples.note: Noun + の + 間 gives the period during which it happens.

examples.ja: 授業（じゅぎょう）の間（あいだ）、ずっと外（そと）を見（み）ていた。
examples.romaji: Jugyō no aida, zutto soto o mite ita.
examples.tr: During the class, I was looking outside the whole time.
examples.note: ずっと and ～ていた show the action continued the whole period.

examples.ja: 駅（えき）と学校（がっこう）の間（あいだ）に、小（ちい）さな店（みせ）がある。
examples.romaji: Eki to gakkō no aida ni, chiisana mise ga aru.
examples.tr: There is a small shop between the station and the school.
examples.note: Here 間 means a place between two things, not time.

pitfalls: Do not mix up 間 and 間に. For something that keeps going the whole time, use 間 (勉強している間、音楽を聞いていた); for one event at some moment inside the period, use 間に.
With a noun, you need の (夏休みの間). Without it the sentence sounds wrong.
